briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: Crown the Apollo Sun-Clarity Gallery: Lore Price. Enter Apollo Sun-Clarity Gallery on Laurel-Sky Hubris Trial through The Laurel-Sky Gate while the Gate remains Stable Gate with oracle vapor leakage. Reference deity voice is Athena, but the player still chooses one deity from the faction roster. Objective: With one selected deity, open the relic detour in the Apollo Sun-Clarity Gallery, secure the hidden memory, and take the reward without awakening the wrong memory.

missionIntro.speaker: Athena Divine Voice
missionIntro.text: The contest begins the moment pride enters the arena. The Apollo Sun-Clarity Gallery will know whether one deity is enough.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lore Director
enemyIntroduction.text: Enemies are not filler here; they are the treasure or lore pressure of Laurel-Sky Hubris Trial made hostile.

midBattle.speaker: Gameplay Director
midBattle.text: Read the room law first: Exploit or avoid the route rule: oracle vapors that reveal possible futures as traps

victory.speaker: Athena Divine Voice
victory.text: The laurel burns only those who mistook glory for right.

defeat.speaker: Athena Divine Voice
defeat.text: Withdraw. The The Laurel-Sky Gate has learned too much from this attempt.

codex.speaker: Lore Director
codex.text: The Celestial Heights of Olympus is the source Realm; mortal myth is only the later echo. This beat documents Apollo Sun-Clarity Gallery as part of Laurel-Sky Hubris Trial.

soloDeityPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield deity; roster/Deity language is excluded from standard mission combat.
visualDirection: Frame Apollo Sun-Clarity Gallery as a treasure or lore node in Laurel-Sky Hubris Trial; living marble-light bodies, bronze cuirasses, laurel circuits, aegis scales, thunder tribunal auras, oracle smoke, amphitheater armor curves, hoplite shield geometry, winged victory accents, gold-blue skyfire, carved but non-readable relief bands.

mythosGatesDialogueRecreation.speakerRule: Use faction divine voice, Lore Director, or Gameplay Director; no playable deity language.
mythosGatesDialogueRecreation.soloRule: Dialogue supports one active god or goddess in the field.
